policy.ARITHMETICALLY_EXCLUDED: A cited exact certificate, together with its explicitly named theorem inputs, proves that no characteristic-zero K3 over QQ has the requested full rational Neron-Severi marking.
policy.ARITHMETICALLY_POSSIBLE: An exact characteristic-zero witness proves that at least one K3 over QQ has geometric Picard rank 19 and all nineteen generators of the requested Neron-Severi lattice defined over QQ.
policy.UNKNOWN: Neither of the preceding proof standards has been met. Failure to find a point, a positive-density local screen, a coarse Clifford curve, or a formal p-adic branch does not change this status.
policy.UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXPLICIT_REASON: A Phase-1 certificate has identified the exact stable marked curve, but its rational non-CM locus is not yet decided. Such a row remains UNKNOWN in the three-way equation-dispatch classifier and must record the exact remaining rational-point or lift obstruction.
